_comment: Sysadmin-agent-only view of the helpdesk-test K8s 3-hop escalation demo target. Deliberately NOT shared with the DB agent's or the gateway's own infrastructure.json: the DB agent must see this server as unregistered (no docker/K8s hint) so it takes its existing 'unknown hosting -> escalate to sysadmin' branch, and the gateway must never resolve this connection_string at all (buildServerTypeHint would otherwise inject a 'do NOT use kubectl' hint into every hop's prompt, including the K8s agent's). This file gives the sysadmin agent the CMDB-depth view — k8s_cluster/k8s_pod_selector — that lets check_host actually reach the pod once it decides to look deeper. See docs/RIGHTS_AND_THE_FLYWHEEL.md and the 3-hop escalation chain plan for the full narrative.
